title: kid is a lookup hint, not unique
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; HCERT Specification, 3.2.3 Key Identifier. QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “a verifier that finds several DSCs with the same kid MUST try all of them”.

statements.label: kid is a lookup hint, not unique
statements.requirement: Trust-list lookup by kid SHALL return every matching DSC, and the verifier SHALL try each candidate until one verifies. A kid match alone SHALL NOT count as authentication.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-KID-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-VER-006 STT-KID-002 a kid nobody trusts fails the trust lookup` (VerifyTest.kt)).
